text_block_list.text: I love races.

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
――And the lead changes! It's Symboli Rudolf!
She's ahead by a length!
Will this be her 8th consecutive 
win, obtaining the Triple Crown while
undefeated!?

I love races where them just running gets
my 
blood pumping.
I love races where the Uma Musume 
pour their all in to chasing their dreams.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Huu……Haaaaaaaaaaaa!!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
――Symboli Rudolf……crosses the goal!
An undefeated 
Triple Crown Uma Musume, now! Right here,
has been born!

The whole world changes in an instant after
crossing the goal. 
Records and memories woven together in to
a drama――

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
――In conclusion! As you trainers know,
in recent years, 
the racing world has really been heating
up!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
For example!
Classic Races that can only challenged
once 
during your career…… [Satsuki Sho] [The
Japan Derby] 
[Kikka Sho] ――commonly called the Classic
Triple Crown!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
A set of races,
where even winning just one will 
bestow honor! Further,
winning all three of these…… 
becoming a Triple Crown Uma Musume,
is a true feat!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
However, recently! In two consecutive years,
a Triple Crown Uma Musume has appeared!
With Symboli Rudolf 
becoming an unprecedented Undefeated Triple
Crown!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
As a result!
There has been an increase in the 
number of Uma Musume who aspire to race,
making the role of trainer more and more
important!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Therefore,
I have high expectations! As trainers, 
I'd like you to support the futures of each
student! 
To further stir up the racing world!

text_block_list.name: Senpai Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Hmmmmmm~!
So you saw each of Symboli Rudolf's Triple
Crown 
races in person,
huh? I couldn't see them because of work.

The memories of that day overflowed,
and the excitement was 
obvious in my voice.
The enthusiasm of the Uma Musume and the 
excitement and expectations of the crowd……it
was unforgettable

text_block_list.name: Senpai Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see. 
You really like races don't you?

text_block_list.name: Senpai Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Hahaa, how honest. With that much enthusiasm,
it'd be great 
if you could raise the next Triple Crown
Uma Musume, huh?

text_block_list.name: Senpai Trainer
text_block_list.text: Hm?
choice_data_list: "First Ever" has a nice ring to it.

text_block_list.name: Senpai Trainer
text_block_list.text:
! 
Then that means, you're aiming for――

There were already several Classic Triple
Crown Uma 
Musume. However, in this country,
there was still 
another Classic Crown that nobody had achieved
yet.

『Oka Sho』 『Oaks』 『Shuuka Sho』…… 
The Crown for the winner of these three
races――

I heard a small laugh……when I turned
around, 
there was a mature-looking Uma Musume standing
nearby.

She had appeared suddenly,
and the atmosphere changed 
immediately.
Her eyes had a mysterious color――
choice_data_list: (I can't take my eyes off her……)

text_block_list.text:
So, you want it, do you? 
A pure and dazzling treasure……

Then, you need to hurry. 
Before someone else……gets their hands on
it.

text_block_list.name: Senpai Trainer
text_block_list.text:
…………………… Ha……! 
M-Mejiro Ramonu……

Famous in the racing world,
the Mejiro family…… One after another, 
many strong Uma Musume bearing the name
Mejiro have appeared.

And she was someone from that Mejiro family.
They rarely ran in front of other people,
and amongst the trainers, 
their true ability was a mystery.
There were rumors though――

That mysterious aura and her cryptic words
remained in my mind…… 
Now I was interested in just how she would
run.

text_block_list.name: Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Ramonu. 
How is the painting progressing?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Oh, grandmother. 
Just now,
it's starting to look good. Take a look……

text_block_list.name: Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
…………Is that so? 
Seems like……you've finally come close to
completing it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I've made you wait quite a long time……
However, because 
of that,
I'm very satisfied with the way it has taken
shape.

text_block_list.name: Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I can tell.
Your heart…… is made quite 
clear in this picture. As expected,
for you――

text_block_list.name: Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
The Tiara would be most suitable.
Much more so than any 
trophy or crown…… Just by seeing your picture,
I can tell.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Servant A
text_block_list.text: ……Do you get it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Servant B
text_block_list.text:
Not at all.
It just looks like she's adding 
more colors on top of each other……

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Grandmother. From the moment these 
legs started running……I understood.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
There was only one thing that should be
placed on this head……

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I'll devote it all. 
All of……――my love.

It was several days after I had met Mejiro
Ramonu. 
I wanted to see her run,
so I was looking for her……

text_block_list.name: Senpai Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Hey! You should hurry up and head to the
course! 
――Mejiro Ramonu is going to be running……real
soon!
